macros.name: zkvlabel
macros.doc: Similar to \zlabel this creates a label.

macros.name: zlabel
macros.doc: Similar to \label the macro \zlabel writes a reference entry in the .aux file.

macros.name: zrefused
macros.doc: With \zrefused LaTeX is notified, if the references are not yet available and LaTeX can generate the rerun hint.
